## Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the capability or improvement you are proposing.

## Problem or Use Case
What problem does this solve? What failure mode, research experiment, or enterprise agent scenario does this enable?

## Proposed Architecture / Solution
How do you envision this being integrated into the existing codebase (e.g. `lifeforge/evolution/mutators/`, `lifeforge/sandbox/`, `lifeforge/metrics/`)?

## Additional Context
Links to academic papers, related CVEs, or tool specifications.
